playstationGameLibrary20261109.catalog: The OnlyGames HTML snapshot provided all 4,465 PS4/PS5 listings and 51,107 package links. An additional two existing Black Ops listings contribute seven links. scripts/import-playstation-library.cjs regenerates the public metadata files from a saved copy of the source HTML. The importer does not download package files.
playstationGameLibrary20261109.delivery: The existing CUSA57548 1.11 crash fix is a direct file link and follows the Pages artifact's exact-revision delivery rewrite when offloaded. Other imports use their original host routes. Mocha's stable share URLs are retained; expiring signed transfer URLs and third-party verification tokens are not imported. No files were added to the archive.
playstationGameLibrary20261109.ads: The catalog uses the site's existing labelled ad placement below the results.
playstationGameLibrary20261109.visualTheme: Both library routes use a white and gray palette and a silver wave inspired by the PS3 XMB. Edge verified the desktop and 390 px mobile layouts, package dialog, Mocha package route and static wave under reduced motion.
playstationGameLibrary20261109.discovery: Refreshed card search tags, descriptions, keywords and sharing metadata for the library, both console game download pages, DLC, updates and FPKG fixes. Library search accepts game aliases, Roman numerals and formatted CUSA or PPSA IDs. The sitemap contains all six canonical routes and excludes the noindex package page. Verified against the real catalog and passed 37 focused tests.
playstationGameLibrary20261109.keywordExpansion: Added PS4 and PS5 game download search variants, package links, regions, DLC and title update phrases. Verified that all existing keywords remained and that the three public HTML sources contain 81, 81 and 49 unique keywords. Both library cards carry the new download aliases.
playstationGameLibrary20261109.localizedDiscovery: Refreshed localized keywords and page text for the library, PS4 and PS5 game downloads, DLC, updates and FPKG fixes in all 20 languages. Each language sitemap gains the library, DLC and Updates routes. Package pages stay noindex and preserve the selected language when visitors open a package or return to the library. Reviewed the core PS4 and PS5 download phrases in all languages and verified 140 generated routes, 31 focused tests, and the English, French and Arabic package flow in Edge.
playstationGameLibrary20261109.checks: Validated complete metadata import, generation of the PS4 directory link, Pages budget and package rewrite, and the desktop and mobile routes in Edge.

routeAndTheme.legacy: The old PS4 library and package URLs redirect while preserving game/file query parameters, hashes and all 20 locale prefixes.
routeAndTheme.visual: Black with white XMB waves by default. A persistent light mode works across the library and package pages. Edge checks covered 320, 390, 768 and 1440 CSS pixels.
routeAndTheme.sharing: Added a dedicated 1200 × 630 social PNG and large Open Graph and Twitter previews on the new canonical.
routeAndTheme.sources: Restored original listings for 7,861 DLPSGame entries and 12,512 published archive download destinations. Eight hundred previously empty entries gained package destinations, with three retaining an original-listing fallback. Existing download URLs and pins were verified unchanged. External package actions go directly to their published host or download page. Game cards omit link counts and source labels.
routeAndTheme.ads: The existing catalog ad stays below the results. Added the same labelled placement below package details on the noindex package page.
routeAndTheme.motionAndLanguage: The fixed XMB wave drifts behind the full page and stays still under reduced motion. Both library routes use the shared site language dropdown and picker, preserving the query and hash across localized catalog and package pages.

dlpsgameImport.coverage: Imported all 6,547 PS4 and 1,314 PS5 posts from the two public WordPress category snapshots. All 7,861 listings have artwork, stored as 7,860 distinct local JPEG thumbnails. The existing 4,467 listings and their details were verified unchanged.
dlpsgameImport.delivery: Added 47,059 PS4 and 5,363 PS5 package links from 29 file hosts. Public host URLs were checked for format and temporary signatures. Individual package availability was not tested. Provider listing URLs and gated wrapper routes were excluded. No game files were mirrored.
dlpsgameImport.fallback: Of 803 posts without an imported host link, 641 show other listings on the same platform with a matching title ID. The other 162 are marked source unavailable. The library continues to publish English and 20 translations.
dlpsgameImport.regenerate: Save public WordPress API post arrays for categories 4370 (PS4) and 63019 (PS5). Store the first post image as a local JPEG thumbnail in assets/images/playstation-library/dlpsgame, named by the first 20 hexadecimal characters of the SHA-256 of its canonical URL. Run node scripts/import-dlpsgame-library.cjs <PS4.json> <PS5.json>. The importer preserves earlier entries and links.

ps5HubParity20261109.status: Implemented and verified in the main site checkout.
ps5HubParity20261109.changes: Matched the PS4 hub's Games and More grids. Kept firmware, Y2JB, payloads and transfer tools in separate sections. The game downloads card opens the existing PS4 downloads page, which links to the shared PS4/PS5 Game Library. Updated the PS5 mods page with actual Encore Zombies, Oxagon and Sheriff menu screenshots and kept native PS5 cheats separately labelled.
ps5HubParity20261109.saves: Added the GarlicSaves community sample directory, the existing PS4 save catalogue for PS4 editions, pinned Garlic SaveMgr v1.14 and official PlayStation backup guidance. Community sample files are labelled as potentially incomplete; no new save files are mirrored.
ps5HubParity20261109.archive: Reused the existing v1.14 ELF. Verified 1721560 bytes and SHA-256 aaec2cb0a39e94217665652fd84fa7706f09c9f8640c07785b6a68b1711f18fc on F: and recorded the additional page in the audit. No payloads were executed.
ps5HubParity20261109.checks: Edge verified the matching desktop card dimensions and order, two-column mobile layout, image loading, save page and shared downloads destination. All 29 focused tests passed; two broader category-art manifest checks also failed on the unchanged checkout. Save import was not tested on a console.

artworkUpdate.changes: The PS5 hub uses God of War III Remastered and Astro Bot for Game downloads, plus ProsperoStore, PlaydenPS5 and Orbit for Apps. The original images render together at their full aspect ratios. The hub and save guide now use the official PS5 Saved Data settings screenshot.
artworkUpdate.persistence: The hub generator selects the sources in build-console-guides.cjs and console-card-media.cjs. Fixed cards bypass the automatic category artwork pass. Edge verified the covers and their aspect ratios on desktop and mobile, and repeating both generators preserved the HTML exactly. The new regression test passed. An existing broader test still expects SVG for five unrelated category covers delivered as JPEG.
